home.emptyBody: Create a goal like “1000 push-ups” and start counting.
home.dragHint: Hold a card to drag it to a new place.
home.dragHintHandle: Drag a card by the dots on its left to move it, or press Alt+↑ / Alt+↓ on a selected card.

stats.empty: Nothing logged yet. Statistics appear after your first entry.

sync.title: Dropbox sync
sync.hint: Tasks, entries and settings are kept in one file, tally-sync.json, in the app’s folder in your Dropbox (Apps). Connect the same account on another device and both merge: new things are added, and when the same thing changed in both places, the later change wins.
sync.disconnectMessage: This device stops syncing. Its data stays, and so does the file in Dropbox for your other devices.

problems.network: No connection to Dropbox. Changes will go up at the next sync.
problems.revoked: Dropbox no longer lets Tally in. Connect again.
problems.scope: The Dropbox app lacks file permissions (files.content.read and files.content.write).
problems.rateLimit: Dropbox asked to slow down. Try again in a minute.
problems.server: Dropbox didn’t answer properly. Try again later.
problems.fileInvalid: The sync file in Dropbox is damaged, so nothing was changed. Delete tally-sync.json in Dropbox to start over from this device.
problems.newerFormat: The sync file was written by a newer Tally. Update the app on this device.
problems.conflict: Other devices kept syncing at the same moment. Try again.
problems.passwordRequired: The data in Dropbox is encrypted. Enter its password to continue syncing.
problems.passwordChanged: The password was changed on another device. Enter the new one to continue syncing.
problems.cloudNotEncrypted: The file in Dropbox is not encrypted, but this device expects it to be: encryption was turned off elsewhere, or the file was replaced. Nothing was changed.

sync.encryptionOnPending: on, applies at the next sync
sync.encryptionOffPending: turning off at the next sync
sync.disconnectEncrypted: This device also forgets the sync password: connecting again will ask for it.

encryption.title: Encrypt data in Dropbox
encryption.intro: Tally keeps your data in one file in your Dropbox. With a sync password, that file is encrypted on this device before it is uploaded, so nobody who can see your Dropbox, Dropbox included, can read your tasks and history.
encryption.cloudChecking: Checking what is in your Dropbox now…
encryption.cloudPlain: The file in your Dropbox is not encrypted now. As soon as you confirm, Tally replaces it with an encrypted one. Dropbox may keep earlier unencrypted versions for a while (30 days or more, depending on your plan). If that matters, delete them at dropbox.com (version history and deleted files).
encryption.cloudNone: There is no file in your Dropbox yet. The first one will be encrypted.
encryption.cloudUnknown: Tally couldn’t check the file in your Dropbox right now. The next sync replaces it with an encrypted one. Dropbox may keep earlier unencrypted versions for a while (30 days or more); delete them at dropbox.com if that matters.
encryption.others: Your other devices stop syncing until you enter the same password on each of them.
encryption.noRecovery: The password is not stored anywhere and cannot be recovered. If you forget it, the encrypted file can’t be opened. Your devices keep their own data, and you can start over from any of them.
encryption.exportNote: Backups made with Export are not encrypted.
encryption.onIntro: The data in your Dropbox is encrypted. To change the password, type a new one twice. To turn encryption off, leave both fields empty: at the next sync the file in Dropbox becomes unencrypted.
encryption.onOthers: Your other devices ask for the new password (or notice that encryption is off) the next time they sync.
encryption.history: Dropbox keeps earlier versions of the file for a while. Versions made while encryption was on stay encrypted, and open with the password that was set then.
encryption.enterIntro: The data in your Dropbox is encrypted, probably with a password set on another device. Enter that password to continue syncing here.
encryption.enterChanged: The password for the data in your Dropbox was changed on another device. Enter the new one to continue syncing here.
encryption.resetIntro: This replaces the file in your Dropbox with the data on this device, under a new password, or without one if you leave the fields empty.
encryption.resetOthers: Nothing is deleted on your devices. Each of them keeps its data and adds it back to the new file once you enter the new password there.
encryption.resetLoss: Only what exists in the old encrypted file and on no device is lost.
encryption.fieldsHint: At least {{min}} characters. Leave both empty to keep the data unencrypted.
encryption.fieldsHintOn: At least {{min}} characters. Leave both empty to turn encryption off.

errors.failed: Couldn’t save the change. Try again.

unlock.wrong: This password doesn’t open the file.
unlock.notEncrypted: The file in Dropbox isn’t encrypted any more. Syncing carries on.
unlock.offline: Can’t reach Dropbox. Check the connection and try again.
unlock.failed: The file in Dropbox couldn’t be read. Try again later.

backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: Export saves every task and its history to one file you can keep in Drive, Telegram or email. Import merges a backup into this device: new items are added, and where both changed the same item, the newer change wins.
backup.nothingNew: Nothing new: this device already has everything in the file.
backup.notBackup: This isn't a Tally backup file.
backup.newerFormat: This backup was made by a newer version of Tally. Update the app to import it.
backup.invalid: The backup file is damaged. Nothing was imported.
